description: This file defines the EncounterValidator class, which implements validation logic for Encounter objects within the OpenMRS medical record system. It checks for required fields, consistency between encounter and visit patient data, and proper encounter date ranges.

classes.name: EncounterValidator
classes.description: A validator class for the Encounter object, supporting validation operations such as checking mandatory fields and date consistency.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class supports validation of the given class type, specifically Encounter class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the Encounter object, ensuring required fields are filled, date ranges are valid, and the encounter's patient and visit data are consistent.
